import datetime, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time
out = pathlib.Path("/workspace/scratch/297a393433ba/native-validation/frozen-1e5667354")
steps = [
 ("retained-tests", ["cargo", "test", "--offline", "--locked", "--manifest-path", "trillionnium/Cargo.toml", "-p", "trnm-research-protocol", "--lib", "--tests", "--all-features"]),
 ("strict-clippy", ["cargo", "clippy", "--offline", "--locked", "--manifest-path", "trillionnium/Cargo.toml", "-p", "trnm-research-protocol", "--all-targets", "--all-features", "--", "-D", "warnings"])
]
records = []
for label, argv in steps:
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    monotonic_start = time.monotonic_ns()
    stdout, stderr = out / (label + ".stdout"), out / (label + ".stderr")
    with stdout.open("xb") as so, stderr.open("xb") as se:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, stdout=so, stderr=se, check=False)
    records.append({"label":label,"argv":argv,"exit_code":result.returncode,
                    "started_utc":started,"ended_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                    "elapsed_ns":time.monotonic_ns()-monotonic_start,
                    "stdout_file":stdout.name,"stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(stdout.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                    "stderr_file":stderr.name,"stderr_sha256":hashlib.sha256(stderr.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
summary={"schema":"sp27-03.native-validation-batch.v1","source_binding":"parent original record_pq_native_command before/after receipt", "steps":records}
with (out/"retained-and-clippy-step-results.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(summary,f,sort_keys=True,indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(r["exit_code"] == 0 for r in records) else 1)
